question: Who is the author of the novel 'Life and Death of Sambhaji' published in the year 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Medha Deshmukh Bhaskaran**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The novel 'Life and Death of Sambhaji' was authored by **Medha Deshmukh Bhaskaran**.
 
• The book was published in the year **2021**.
 
• Medha Deshmukh Bhaskaran is known for her detailed and well-researched historical novels.
 
• The novel focuses on the life and times of **Sambhaji Maharaj**, the second Chhatrapati of the Maratha Empire.
 
• The book provides a comprehensive account of Sambhaji Maharaj's contributions and struggles during his reign.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sambhaji Maharaj**

 
 
• He was the eldest son of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj and succeeded him as the ruler of the Maratha Empire.
 
• Sambhaji Maharaj's reign lasted from 1681 to 1689.
 
• He faced numerous challenges, including conflicts with the Mughal Empire, Portuguese, and Siddis.
 
• He is remembered for his valor, administrative skills, and dedication to preserving the Maratha sovereignty.
 
 
 
• **Historical Novels**
 
 
• These are novels set in a past time period, often incorporating real historical events and characters.
 
• They aim to provide readers with a deeper understanding of historical events through the lens of fictional narratives.
 
• Authors often conduct extensive research to ensure historical accuracy and authenticity in their storytelling.
 
• Historical novels can cover various genres, including romance, adventure, and drama, set against historical backdrops.
 
 
 
• **Medha Deshmukh Bhaskaran**
 
 
• She is a well-regarded author in the field of historical fiction.
 
• Her works are known for their meticulous research and engaging narrative style.
 
• In addition to 'Life and Death of Sambhaji,' she has written other notable works, contributing significantly to Indian historical literature.
 
• Her books often focus on prominent figures and events in Indian history, offering readers an immersive experience.
